What does Chhath Puja look like on the ghats of Patna?
In this ground report, women share their experiences of keeping a 36 hour fast without food or water and talk about the deep faith behind this festival. The report also asks an important question, why do men not observe Chhath fasts?
Watch this video to see the devotion, colors and stories from Patna’s ghats during one of Bihar’s biggest festivals.
